milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the damaged anvil and face it to demonstrate they have located it. The damaged anvil is placed at spawn-relative (0, 0, 6) inside a blacksmith workshop. The player spawns approximately 6 blocks away near the entrance, so requiring max_distance=3 ensures they must actively walk forward ~3 blocks toward the anvil while facing it (within 60 degrees). This correctly models 'player has found and is looking at the damaged anvil'.
